description: Validate an XML document with xmlvalid: well-formedness, an XSD, DTD or RelaxNG schema, and for e-invoices the Schematron business rules of EN 16931, Peppol BIS, XRechnung, Factur-X and national formats. Pass the document as `xml` (its text) or `url` (a public http(s) address), and a `schema`: a catalog slug from search_schemas, a saved schema ("@orders-v3"), or "auto" to use the e-invoice profile the document names. Without a schema only well-formedness is checked. Returns valid, errors and warnings with line, column, message, rule and a help_url explaining each. Counts as one API validation of the key's monthly quota.

name.description: A file name to show in the result, such as invoice-42.xml.

rules_version.description: Pin Schematron rule sets to releases, as rule-set@version, comma-separated (peppol-bis-3-ubl@3.0.21): the call fails with rules_version_mismatch when one has moved on. The result's rule_sets lists the releases that ran.

schema.description: A catalog slug (see search_schemas), "@<name>" for a saved schema, or "auto" for the e-invoice profile the document names. Leave out to check well-formedness only.

url.description: A public http(s) URL of the document, fetched by xmlvalid.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a pending status to poll with get_validation.

xml.description: The XML document itself. Use url instead for a document on the web.

name: validate_xml
title: Validate Xml
